recorded_select_queries.managed_schemas: SELECT name,USER_NAME(principal_id) FROM sys.schemas WHERE name=N'crm' OR name LIKE N'crm[_]%' ORDER BY name
recorded_select_queries.managed_objects: SELECT s.name,o.name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (s.name=N'crm' OR s.name LIKE N'crm[_]%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name
recorded_select_queries.database_ddl_triggers: SELECT name,is_disabled,OBJECT_DEFINITION(object_id) FROM sys.triggers WHERE parent_class=0 ORDER BY name
recorded_select_queries.server_ddl_triggers: SELECT name,is_disabled,is_ms_shipped FROM sys.server_triggers ORDER BY name
